The dental campus

The dental college and clinics form a separate campus area, approximately 1 km from the nursing compound.

Living on campus

The dental campus has its own dining hall and hostels, with staff quarters opposite.

Courses and admissions

For course details, entry requirements, approved seats and council approvals, please contact the college office. We’ll share the current information for your admission year.

BDS · Undergraduate

The Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) is the undergraduate dental programme at SVS Institute of Dental Sciences. Teaching combines dental sciences with pre-clinical practice and clinical learning.

MDS · Postgraduate

The Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) provides postgraduate study in dental specialties. SVS introduced MDS programmes in eight branches from 2009–10. Confirm the current specialty list and admission-year availability with the dental college.

Contact the college office

For dental course details and admission enquiries, call 08542-227902 or email svsmc_mbnr@yahoo.co.in.
